title: A Hollywood star vanished after naming a famous actor in a torn note — what was on the missing half?
description:
On October 8th, 1949, a torn purse was found in Griffith Park. Inside was a note cut off mid-sentence, mentioning names that led detectives into the darkest corners of Golden Age Hollywood.

Jean Spangler, a 27-year-old actress and single mother, had told her sister-in-law she was meeting her ex-husband and then heading to a film shoot. She never came home. No body, no arrest, and no record of any shoot she was booked for. One name in the note — Kirk — pointed toward a major star who denied ever knowing her. Another name led to whispers of an illegal abortion ring connected to the studios.

Seventy-five years later, the missing half of that note has never surfaced — and neither has Jean.
